answer: Bind every identity to a private history only it can recall: to act, an agent must solve a cipher built from its own past answers, a chain of memories no newcomer can buy. An honest agent keeps its record like a ferrous chain, each link forged by its own work, but a Sybil farmer must fabricate a full, distinct history for every fake — a fable told a thousand times, each version costly to invent and easy for peers to cross-check. Forging one past is hard; forging a thousand is ruinous.
